top_stories.title: Phishing-Resistant Isn't Enough; Yubico Takes Aim at Identity-Verification Gap
top_stories.summary: Yubico launched YubiID, a new service that bridges identity verification with credential enrollment and recovery across existing identity platforms to address gaps in phishing-resistant authentication. The announcement also includes a post-quantum YubiKey beta, extending hardware authentication capabilities to quantum-resistant cryptography.

top_stories.title: Microsoft disrupts EvilTokens phishing service after thousands of accounts targeted
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disrupted the EvilTokens phishing-as-a-service operation after it was used to target thousands of accounts. The service exploited a legitimate Microsoft authentication process to bypass security controls without using a conventional fake login page, representing a token-based attack on Microsoft's auth infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
top_stories.summary: Hackers are conducting phishing campaigns using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to steal Microsoft and Google account credentials and authentication sessions. The attacks leverage two phishing-as-a-service platforms to capture both credentials and authentication session tokens, bypassing MFA protections.

top_stories.title: Closing the Identity Gap at the Service Desk
top_stories.summary: Attackers are exploiting IT service desks as a vector to bypass MFA by impersonating employees and requesting password resets or new authentication device registrations. Specops Software outlines why traditional identity verification methods are insufficient for account recovery and proposes approaches to defend against social engineering at the service desk.

top_stories.title: 99% of repository access tokens never expire
top_stories.summary: BlueFlag Security's State of Developer Risk 2026 report found that 99% of repository access tokens never expire, leaving developer, contractor, service account, and AI coding agent permissions active beyond their intended use. The report highlights access review gaps across code repositories, build pipelines, and connected applications as a significant identity governance risk.

news.title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services
news.summary: Chainalysis suffered a breach that exposed names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all users, forcing the company to shut down access to its Reactor and Data Solutions services. The incident involved an agentic cyber attack, with the investigation ongoing and no evidence yet of investigation data being accessed.

news.title: DigiCert data breach exposes customer information, identity documents
news.summary: DigiCert suffered a data breach caused by a server migration error that inadvertently exposed an internal business system to the internet. The breach resulted in unauthorized access to customer information and identity documents.

news.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
news.summary: OpenSSH released emergency patch version 10.6p2 to fix a critical authentication bypass vulnerability affecting Alpine Linux servers running the standard openssh-server package. The flaw allows attackers with network access to bypass SSH authentication on accounts with no password (such as SSH key-only accounts) by supplying a password between 257 and 1,024 bytes long.

news.title: Moving an organization to passkeys without breaking access
news.summary: This article presents a phased migration roadmap for moving organizations from MFA to passkeys within Microsoft Entra ID, covering SMS/voice retirement deadlines and readiness metrics. It is part seven of a seven-part series addressing threat modeling, credential management, and access continuity during the transition.

news.title: Most consumers aren’t ready to let AI agents shop unsupervised
news.summary: Okta has released its 2026 Customer Identity Trends Report examining consumer attitudes toward AI agents performing actions like shopping and booking services on their behalf. The report highlights that customer control, account security, and ease of use are key factors influencing adoption of AI agents that access personal information.

news.title: Vercel rolls out new protection against stolen session cookie attacks
news.summary: Vercel is rolling out Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) on its platform to protect against stolen session cookie attacks from information stealer malware. DBSC cryptographically binds session credentials to a specific device, preventing attackers from reusing stolen cookies on other machines.

news.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
news.summary: DreamHost suffered a data breach in which attackers accessed its File Manager platform for two months, stealing customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. The breach involved credential theft and unauthorized access to webmail sessions, touching on authentication and access management concerns.

news.title: mSecure Warns Users to Change Passwords, Reset 2FA and Passkeys After Suspicious Activity
news.summary: mSecure password manager developer mSeven Software issued a warning to users on November 3 advising them to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys following detection of suspicious activity. The company sent the alert via email but has not yet disclosed the full nature or scope of the incident.

news.title: 7 Best Security Add-Ons for Microsoft Entra in 2026
news.summary: An article compares seven security add-ons designed to extend Microsoft Entra's capabilities across identity verification, privileged access management, legacy authentication, hardware-backed keys, and directory recovery. The piece targets IAM professionals evaluating third-party tools to complement or enhance their Microsoft Entra deployments.

news.title: AWS DataSync Enhanced mode supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) for Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure
news.summary: AWS DataSync Enhanced mode has added OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication support for Google Cloud Storage and Microsoft Azure Blob Storage locations. The feature uses AWS IAM roles to obtain short-lived credentials from Google Cloud and Azure for secure cross-cloud data transfer authentication.

news.title: Barracuda Flaws Could Be Chained to Bypass Authorization and Gain Root Access
news.summary: Barracuda disclosed two vulnerabilities—a pre-authentication authorization bypass (CVE-2026-116606, CVSS 9.3) and a command injection flaw—that can be chained to bypass authorization controls and gain root access on affected devices. The flaws are notable for the authorization bypass component, which allows unauthenticated attackers to circumvent access controls before exploiting the second vulnerability.

news.title: Who will security companies buy next in AI agent identity?
news.summary: A Fortune 500 company discovered over 10,000 unknown AI agents during a SailPoint proof of concept engagement, highlighting the growing challenge of AI agent identity governance. The article examines acquisition targets in the AI agent identity security space as vendors like SailPoint expand focus on non-human identity management.

news.title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway can be configured to perform on-behalf-of (OBO) token exchange with Microsoft Entra ID, enabling AI agents to call the ServiceNow REST API while preserving the originating user's identity. The integration involves AgentCore Gateway natively handling the token exchange process between the AI agent and downstream services.

news.title: Opal’s agent.ID virtual event: Top security leaders on governing Al agents
news.summary: Opal Security will host agent.ID, a free virtual event on November 5, 2026, focused on adapting IAM practices to AI agents. The event will feature CISOs and identity leaders from companies including Elastic, Instacart, Notion, Databricks, and Knostic discussing AI agent governance.

news.title: Oh, your agents need OAuth2, too
news.summary: Dan Moore, Senior Director of CIAM Strategy and Identity Standards at FusionAuth, discussed adapting OAuth2 protocols for autonomous AI agents at the LDX3 conference by LeadDev. The conversation covered the security necessity of giving AI agents their own distinct identities and applying established authorization frameworks to agentic systems.

news.title: Amazon Quick on desktop now uses your organization's existing Amazon Quick sign-in
news.summary: Amazon Quick has updated its desktop application to use the same organizational sign-in method already configured for the web version, eliminating the need for a separate OIDC application registration in the identity provider. This change simplifies IAM administration by removing the requirement for administrators to set up and manage an additional OIDC integration for the desktop client.

news.title: Okta to Announce Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on December 1, 2026
news.summary: Okta announced it will release its third quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results on December 1, 2026. The results will cover the quarter ended October 31, 2026, and will be released after U.S. market close.

news.title: Phishing-resistant MFA where it matters most, and finding the privileged identities your role report misses
news.summary: This article covers implementing phishing-resistant MFA and passkeys in Microsoft Entra ID, specifically focused on protecting privileged administrator accounts. The piece is part six of a seven-part series addressing privileged identity protection and discovering identities that may be missed in standard role reports.

news.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
news.summary: Microsoft released a patch update addressing more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities across Windows operating systems and other software. The patch batch surpasses the previous record of nearly 1,000 fixes issued in September.
